leadText:
Sylvester (Japanese: サンシロー Sanshirō) is a character of the day who appeared in Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!. He participated in the Club Battle tournament, but lost in a against Georgia, thus getting knocked out in the very first round.

He reappeared in a flashback in A Unova League Evolution!.
plainText:
Sylvester (Japanese: サンシロー Sanshirō) is a character of the day who appeared in Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!. He participated in the Club Battle tournament, but lost in a against Georgia, thus getting knocked out in the very first round.

He reappeared in a flashback in A Unova League Evolution!.

==Pokémon==
 

Sylvester has at least two other Pokémon as those who entered the Club Battle were required to enter with three Pokémon.

==Pokémon competitions==
Club Battle - Top 16 (Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!)

==Voice actors==
 

==Trivia==
Sylvester's character design resembles that of Joltik's color scheme.
